sql:
-- Compute top 20% among only products that exist in the products table
WITH qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
        AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) * 1.2
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        pq.prod_id,
        pq.calendar_quarter_id,
        pq.product_sales,
        SUM(pq.product_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY pq.calendar_quarter_id) as total_sales_by_quarter,
        pq.product_sales * 1.0 / SUM(pq.product_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY pq.calendar_quarter_id) as share
    FROM product_quarter_sales pq
),
product_combined AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_totals
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_with_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.prod_id,
        pc.total_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY pc.total_sales DESC) as ntile_5
    FROM product_combined pc
    JOIN products p ON pc.prod_id = p.prod_id
),
top_20pct AS (
    SELECT prod_id FROM product_with_rank WHERE ntile_5 = 1
)
SELECT pt.prod_id, p.prod_name, pwr.total_sales
FROM top_20pct pt
JOIN products p ON pt.prod_id = p.prod_id
JOIN product_with_rank pwr ON pt.prod_id = pwr.prod_id
ORDER BY pwr.total_sales DESC
